description: Unique constraints over several columns, and checks

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `slot` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `room` text,
  `starts` integer,
  `ends` integer,
  CONSTRAINT `slot_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `slot_room_starts_unique` UNIQUE(`room`, `starts`),
  CONSTRAINT `slot_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public')),
  CONSTRAINT `slot_check_0` CHECK(`ends` > `starts`)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `slot_owner_index` ON `slot` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `slot_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `slot`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `slot`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `slot_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`room` AS `room`,
  `t`.`starts` AS `starts`,
  `t`.`ends` AS `ends`
FROM `slot` AS `t`
